# ADMIN-D7 Assign (merged into ADMIN-D6)

Merged into ADMIN-D6 on 2026-11-05 (D-L106). Assign is no longer a page or a walkthrough stop: who a list is assigned to is in its panel, and Add students is a dialog. This page is off `_page-registry.json`. Its task IDs N1 to N9 stay valid, under the Skill lists table in the map's section F, and ADMIN-D6 lists them.

An old URL with `?view=assign` opens Skill lists on that list's panel.
